newsitem.title: USA: Fed approves new powers for Bank of Boston.
newsitem.headline: Fed approves new powers for Bank of Boston.

text.p: The Federal Reserve announced on Tuesday its approval for Bank of Boston Corp to engage through a subsidiary in underwriting and dealing in all types of debt and equity securities.

Through subsidiary BancBoston Securities, it will be able to engage worldwide in underwriting and dealing as well as other activities, including providing investment and advisory services and securities brokerage services.
Bank of Boston is the 15th largest U.S. bank with total assets of about $62 billion.
